title: Adversarial Machine Learning for Power Grid Cybersecurity: Attacks and Defenses
relevance_justification: Focuses on ML-based cyberattack detection/defense mechanisms tailored to power-grid measurement manipulation (FDS/FDI) and provides threat models and defenses useful for resilient estimation pipelines.

title: Graph Neural Network for Cyber Attack Detection in Smart Grids
relevance_justification: Applies GNN-based anomaly/intrusion detection to cyber components of smart-grid architectures; useful for detecting coordinated attacks that affect sensor/communication graphs.

title: Robust Power System State Estimation under False Data Injection Attacks
relevance_justification: Studies resilient estimation against FDI attacks and provides design/analysis that directly support ML-driven anomaly scores integrated with state-estimation filters.

title: Deep Learning-Based Detection of Cyber Attacks on Smart Meter Data
relevance_justification: Targets abnormal patterns in smart meter streams with deep anomaly detectors; relevant for detecting compromised measurement channels before they contaminate estimation/control.

title: Time-Series Intrusion Detection for SCADA Systems Using Machine Learning
relevance_justification: Provides ML intrusion-detection methods for SCADA telemetry, a core input to power-grid estimators; can be combined with measurement validation strategies.

title: Secure State Estimation with Learning-Guided Measurement Validation
relevance_justification: Blends robust estimation and learning-based measurement validation; useful as a template for resilient estimation under cyber compromises.

title: Federated Learning for Privacy-Preserving Anomaly Detection in Power Systems Cybersecurity
relevance_justification: Improves scalability of cybersecurity anomaly detection across distributed grid assets while preserving privacy; relevant for real-world multi-operator settings.

title: Adversarially Robust Intrusion Detection for Power Grid Cyber Networks
relevance_justification: Addresses adversarial robustness of ML detectors under attacker-aware conditions; aligns with resilient estimation requirements.

title: Online Anomaly Detection for Smart Grid Cyber Events under Concept Drift
relevance_justification: Focuses on non-stationary cyber behaviors; concept-drift-aware detection improves reliability over the long-term operation of grids.

title: Ransomware Attack Detection in Energy Management Systems via Machine Learning
relevance_justification: Covers ML-based detection of severe cyber incidents in energy management; relevant for resilience and safe recovery planning.

title: Data Poisoning Attacks and Defenses for Learning-Based Power Grid Cybersecurity
relevance_justification: Studies poisoning of training/telemetry used by detectors/estimators; directly relevant for robust resilient estimation under adaptive attackers.

title: Unsupervised Cyber Anomaly Detection in Energy Systems Using Reconstruction-Based Models
relevance_justification: Uses reconstruction/unsupervised learning for anomaly scoring when labeled attack data is scarce; common in practical grid cybersecurity.

title: Explainable Machine Learning for Smart Grid Cyber Attack Detection
relevance_justification: Targets interpretability for operators (feature attribution/decision reasoning) to make anomaly decisions actionable in resilient operations.

title: Co-Simulation of Cyber Attacks and Defensive Detection for Power System Control
relevance_justification: Presents end-to-end evaluation of detection and defenses in control settings; relevant for closing the loop between cyber events and estimation/control resilience.

title: Privacy- and Security-Aware Distributed Anomaly Detection for Power Grid Monitoring
relevance_justification: Designs distributed monitoring with security considerations (e.g., secure aggregation) that can support resilient estimation across multiple sensing zones.
